decision_authority: Explicit project-maintainer M6-04A decision: accept Qwen3 0.6B's measured target-laptop profile without a repeated benchmark and replace only the failed latency gates with the policy below.

runtime.transport: owner-managed direct child process over stdio only

inference_profile.reasoning_mode: non-thinking (/no_think); hidden reasoning, thought tags, and raw template text are not displayable

comparative_fallback.disposition: Selected for later explicit opt-in installation under the M6-04A best-effort latency policy. It remains disabled until M6-05 verifies an artifact and M6-06 implements the bounded worker.

measured_early_rejection.reason: The first comparable sample exceeded cold TTFT, completion, and throughput hard gates. Remaining locales and quality review could not change a hard rejection.

retrieval_boundary.retrieval: chat-only, same active locale, normalized exact float32 matrix
retrieval_boundary.ordinary_search: BPM deterministic documentation search is not called, changed, reranked, or replaced.
retrieval_boundary.optional_external_evidence: disabled by default and never becomes local chunks, embeddings, an index, or chat knowledge

performance_policy.scope: Only the selected Qwen3 0.6B Q8_0 local chat path on the measured CPU-only target laptop profile.
performance_policy.user_visible_promise: Local chat is best effort: BPM makes no fixed target-laptop promise for time to first token or complete-answer latency. It must disclose local CPU processing, remain non-blocking, and provide cancellation when the later worker is available.
performance_policy.accepted_evidence: The complete M6-03 six-locale matrix is accepted as the baseline without a repeat benchmark. Its failed latency values remain visible historical evidence and are not rewritten as a pass.
performance_policy.excluded_candidate_rule: The amendment does not select Qwen3 1.7B or erase its observed early rejection.

release_blocker.reason: The maintainer accepted the measured Qwen3 0.6B best-effort profile and explicitly superseded the latency-only hard gates without a re-benchmark.
effect: M6-05 may implement explicit verified installation for Qwen3 0.6B only.
M6-06 owns the bounded worker only; later M7/M8 controller work owns any chat route. This decision starts neither.
The deterministic documentation search and /help/ remain independent and ready.
release_blocker.resolution_rule: The selected best-effort policy applies only to the named 0.6B artifact/profile. Any model, runtime, quantization, host scope, or user-visible latency promise change requires an explicit new decision and affected evidence.

no_model_fallback.current_product_behavior: Until the user explicitly installs and enables the verified 0.6B artifact, use deterministic documentation search and normal /help/ navigation; do not start, download, or retry a model.
no_model_fallback.future_extractive_behavior: Any later extractive chat answer remains optional, must be grounded in same-locale published citations, and must fail closed to deterministic search when unavailable.
